signal: ConsenSys is preparing a 2026 IPO with JPMorgan and Goldman, MetaMask launched perpetual futures and an Agent Wallet, plus a Mastercard crypto card partnership

email.body1:
Sy, saw ConsenSys line up a 2026 IPO and ship MetaMask perp futures, the Agent Wallet, and the Mastercard card.

Momentum like that opens more co-sell and partner targets than a team can personally cover, and partner-sourced pipeline coverage is where it quietly slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across a partner ecosystem on its own: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for ConsenSys's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: drafts to your top partner targets
email.body2:
Sy, quick follow-up for ConsenSys.

As the partner roster grows pre-IPO, the hard part is covering every co-sell target with personalized outreach at scale. That is exactly where partner-sourced pipeline stalls.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them and how the same engine scales across your ecosystem?
email.body3:
Sy, last bit of proof for ConsenSys.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ConsenSys's reply rate likely compares to similar Web3 and fintech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sy, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. An IPO run-up is its own kind of busy, and timing matters here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays for your partner motion? I'll tailor it to ConsenSys either way.
